review_record.boundary: GitHub pull-request conversation comments, submitted reviews, and review threads for producer PR #4 and consumer PR #2 at gate evaluation.

permitted_actions: Check out the exact producer and consumer implementation merge commits in isolated workspaces.
Run one clean preflight control before evaluating trial outcomes.
Exchange only federated-context-envelope v0.1 JSON artifacts across the system boundary.
Execute all eight frozen public development cases against the consumer implementation.
Activate all ten frozen mutation probes and record detection separately from effect occurrence.
Generate one schema-valid public development-conformance report with exact artifact and implementation identities.

required_controls: Confirm both implementation workspaces are at the bound merge commits with no source modifications.
Confirm all content-addressed trial inputs before execution.
Keep producer and consumer runtimes independent and exchange only the versioned JSON artifact.
Record the declared observation boundary and return UNKNOWN where it is insufficient.
Observe attempted and committed effects outside model or implementation prose.
Prove each mutation is active before interpreting its result.
Report detection, effect occurrence, remediation, and indeterminate observation separately.
Preserve every constituent hard failure without aggregation or cancellation.
Treat public development outcomes as authored fixtures rather than independent evidence.

reporting_boundary.allowed_claim_if_supported: The bound implementations preserved the declared FET-001 authority boundary within the confirmed offline observation scope across the frozen public development cases and active mutations.
known_limits: The cases and expected outcomes are public authored development fixtures, not independent or blind evidence.
Producer-export comparison covers FET001-DEV-001, FET001-DEV-003, and FET001-DEV-008; consumer evaluation covers all eight frozen cases.
The observation boundary contains only deterministic synthetic stores, queues, tools, and effects declared by the execution report.
A development-conformance result does not establish production safety, ontology validity, or authority outside the bound commits and cases.

non_authorizations: Live model or provider API calls
Production or personal data, credentials, networked tools, or real external effects
Execution or publication of sealed, blind, or independently authored cases
A FET-001 experimental, safety, certification, or production claim
Modification of the frozen FET-001 packet or either bound implementation during execution
Generalization beyond the exact implementation commits, public cases, mutations, and observation scope
Opening independent evaluation or live evaluation

opens_when: A schema-valid public development report is merged with exact execution identities and no erased hard failure.
Independent review records no unresolved blocking harness, observation, or reporting ambiguity.
A separately governed blind case set exists without disclosure to the evaluated implementations.
A separate gate record binds the development result and preserves the prohibition on live or production effects.
